description.value: Snackshot is a Hong Kong-style dessert shop reimagining classics like tofu pudding and mahjong tile treats in creative, photo-worthy ways. The Granville Street location is one of three in Metro Vancouver, giving cyclists riding the Granville corridor a convenient spot to refuel with something sweet. The shop also offers catering and a venue space for small events.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 33m; rack (2 spaces) at 37m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Snackshot is a Hong Kong-style dessert shop with three locations, and the 7980 Granville Street, Vancouver address listed in OSM matches exactly. Online ordering ('Order Online') is prominently advertised on the website, confirming takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned in either the OSM tags or any website subpage.
concerns: OSM tags the record as amenity=restaurant, but the business is a dessert/snack shop, not a restaurant in the conventional sense — category is still Food & Drink so no correction needed.
Phone number (+1 604-559-7980) was not in OSM; sourced from the website's location listing for the Granville Street branch.
Prefetch status was 'front_fetch_failed' but cached HTML was available and used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active dessert shop with a confirmed Granville Street address, recent OSM check date (2025-10-08), and a functioning website. Useful stop for touring cyclists on the Granville corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Multi-location chain; Richmond and Kingsway locations may warrant separate OSM records if they exist.

wow_evidence: one of three in Metro Vancouver
